name: The Search Update
notes: Search YouTube Music right in the app: songs, albums, playlists and artists, with a + that turns into a progress ring and then a tick
Artists: search for one, or paste an artist link, and download their albums, singles or top songs
Add from Link now understands artist links too
The player now opens on one smooth glide, with no bounce
Settings rebuilt: fewer sections, shorter rows, everything in one tidy list
Updates inside the app: Settings › About checks for a new version and hands it to SideStore
